Rule v5 — class review cards — round 2 (vendors propose, depth decides)

Built 2026-11-06T13:35:27-06:00, read-only. 36 cards, round 2: each open class topped up to 10 judged cards, drawn at random (seed 51107) from wells that are not labelled, overridden or on any earlier card. Each class is judged on 7/10 with its round-1 cards (a bench code in the proposed unit agrees on the unit). Neighbours are evidence wells only by their LIVE tags. A card whose plain-median check disagrees with the call is marked, not dropped. Mark cards_sample.csv: agree / reject / a bench code / free text (a hold). Nothing is applied.
